snippet.title: Strange Antiquities - Xbox & PlayStation Date Announcement
snippet.description:
Strange Antiquities is coming to Xbox Series X/S and PlayStation 4 & 5 on April 30th. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2885870/Strange_Antiquities/
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/strange-antiquities-switch/

Become the custodian of a store dealing in occult antiquities. Explore the quaint and gloomy town of Undermere, where strange goings-on and dark mysteries abound. Find and identify arcane artefacts, use your collection to aid the townsfolk with their unusual problems — and remember to pet your cat!

Stay up to date with Strange Antiquities and Iceberg Interactive:
